summary: Remembers auction house prices, scans all listings, helps you price your auctions and shows prices in item tooltips.
description: Forever Auctions records the lowest price of each item you see at the auction house, per realm and faction. A full scan button reads every listing at once. The sell tab shows the lowest price and fills in an undercut for you. Item tooltips show the auction price, the vendor price and the value of the stack. Type /fah to open the price history window.
